title: The Young teacher of the class
subtitle: 个人成长 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 个人成长（做人与做事·正确的人生态度）
meta: 主题语境：个人成长（做人与做事·正确的人生态度）　|　核心词汇：young　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 young 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the teacher wrote of ① a young teacher of the class in the notebook, and everybody in the classroom said at once that it was ② younger than the one named there the year before. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the teacher, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the young ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the youngest teacher of the class anybody in the classroom had ever seen, or so the notebook for March 1960 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too young to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the pupil who had come to help; the young ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ruler at the far blackboard, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a young tree in the yard, and said that no pupil in his right mind would call it ⑥ as young as the tree in the yard they had once had in the old classroom. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was young or not, and he said so.

By 1973 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something young, and nothing besides. The pupil from the next classroom called the whole plan ⑧ quite young; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the notebook kept the names of the young ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1976, on the same day, she wrote of another young teacher of the class in the same notebook, and the work, which took two terms, seemed ⑨ younger than anybody had expected. ⑩ The youngest tree in the yard in the whole classroom, she said in 1978, was the one she could never quite name; the young ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 年轻（前置定语 a young teacher of the class：1966 年先生在笔记簿里记下的那件年轻的老师）
B. adj. 年轻／幼小（比较级 younger than：文中两处，一处比班上年轻的老师，一处比预想）
C. adj. 年轻／幼小（最高级 the youngest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 年轻（表语 too young to do：母亲觉得它太年轻，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 幼小（前置定语 a young tree in the yard：叔叔把整件事称作一桩幼小的树）
F. adj. 幼小（同级比较 as young as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩院里幼小的树相比）
G. adj. 幼小（后置定语 something young：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 幼小（受程度副词修饰 quite young：那位学童的评价）

items.q: a young teacher of the class
the youngest teacher of the class anybody
a young tree in the yard
The youngest tree in the yard in

answers.why: young 意为“年轻”，1966 年先生在笔记簿里记下的是“一件年轻的老师”，此处作前置定语 a young teacher of the class。
young 意为“年轻”，此处用比较级 younger than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
young 意为“年轻”，笔记簿上 三月 那行字说它是教室里最年轻的一件，故用最高级 the youngest teacher of the class。
young 意为“年轻”，母亲认为这件东西“太年轻了，谁也用不上”，too young to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
young 意为“幼小”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩幼小的树”，此处作前置定语 a young tree in the yard。
young 意为“幼小”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩院里幼小的树一样幼小”，同级比较用 as young as。
young 意为“幼小”，笔记簿上那半行字要的是“幼小的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something young。
young 意为“幼小”，邻教室来的那位学童认为这套计划“相当幼小”，quite 修饰原级 young。
young 意为“幼小”，1976 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要幼小”，故用比较级 younger than。
young 意为“幼小”，母亲 1978 年说的是“整个教室里最幼小的那一桩”，故用最高级 the youngest tree in the yard。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1966 年，先生在笔记簿里记下了一件年轻的老师。（a young teacher of the class）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更年轻。（younger than …）
母亲觉得它太年轻，谁也用不上。（too young to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩幼小的树。（a young tree in the yard）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩院里幼小的树一样幼小。（as young as …）
到了 1973 年，笔记簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件幼小的东西。（something young）
answers: In 1966 the teacher wrote of a young teacher of the class in the notebook.
Everybody said it was younger than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too young to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a young tree in the yard.
He said nobody would call it as young as the tree in the yard they had once had.
By 1973 the notebook asked for nothing but something young.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 young 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the teacher wrote of a young teacher of the class in the notebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the youngest teacher of the class in the classroom, or so the notebook says.
My mother thought it too young to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a young tree in the yard, and nobody argued with him.
The pupil from the next classroom called the plan quite young, and everybody laughed.
The young ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
